title: Gold, Platinum, and Expected Stock Returns
summary: Owned GC and ES alone do not establish source-matched gold/platinum levels or causal estimation. The unadmitted public daily panel is not permission to substitute continuous futures levels.
about: Gold/platinum relative valuation and expected equity returns.
findings: Authors claim the gold/platinum ratio predicts equity returns and links to a tail-risk state; no independent strategy replication.
mechanism: Time-varying risk compensation could explain predictability; explanatory model and net timing profits remain separate.
build_on: Owned GC and ES alone do not establish source-matched gold/platinum levels or causal estimation. The unadmitted public daily panel is not permission to substitute continuous futures levels.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Possible with full source, source-matched levels, clocks and frozen training/allocation; no rule invented from abstract.
